speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing generalized fatigue and severe itching, along with abnormal liver function results. To begin our assessment, have you noticed any changes in your urine color or stool consistency, such as dark urine or pale stools?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your history of ulcerative colitis and recent changes in bowel habits, have you noticed any pale or clay-colored stools, or have you been taking any new medications, particularly methotrexate or azathioprine? Also, do you have any abdominal pain or jaundice?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC).

The combination of severe pruritus, scleral icterus, fatigue, and your history of autoimmune conditions (ulcerative colitis) is highly suggestive of PBC. Given the confirmed jaundice, we do not need further imaging or liver function panels; we will proceed immediately to confirm the diagnosis with specific serology.
